Northeastern Waukesha County in southeastern Wisconsin...

dangers of flooding.

properties.description:

highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Falls Church, Huntington, Mantua, Pimmit Hills, Crystal City,

- At 8:15 PM EDT Thursday the stage was 18.0 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 18.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected remain nearly steady near 18
feet this evening, before falling to 16.6 feet early Tuesday
afternoon.
- Action stage is 18.0 feet.
- Flood stage is 22.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at weather.gov/pbz.

The next statement will be issued late tonight at 500 AM EDT.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued September 3 at 4:29PM CDT until September 4 at 7:30PM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected.

* WHERE...Hardin County in southeastern Texas...
Northwestern Jefferson County in southeastern Texas...

* WHEN...Until 730 PM CDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Numerous roads
remain closed due to flooding.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 428 PM CDT, Gauge reports and emergency management are
reporting flooding continuing. Flooding is already occurring in
the warned area.
- Flood water are moving down Village Creek, Little Pine Island
Bayou and Pine Island Bayou.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Lumberton, Silsbee, Kountze, Sour Lake, Saratoga, Wildwood,
Thicket, Bevil Oaks, Honey Island, Village Mills, Batson and
Votaw.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction: Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.
